post.description:
Standard OpenTelemetry Protocol (OTLP/HTTP) trace ingestion endpoint.

Accepts standard OTLP JSON (resourceSpans). Scrubs credentials and PII in-memory,
enforces tenant isolation from X-Tenant-ID header or resource attribute,
buffers normalized spans, and updates observed runtime dependencies.

schema.title: Response Ingest Otlp Traces V1 Traces Post

post.description: Authenticated endpoint for submitting OTLP trace payloads scoped to caller tenant.

schema.title: Response Ingest Tenant Traces Api V1 Telemetry Traces Post

get.description: Retrieves observed runtime dependency graph for the authenticated tenant.

schema.title: Response Get Runtime Graph Api V1 Telemetry Runtime Graph Get

get.description: Correlates runtime dependencies with static repository symbols and contracts.

schema.title: Response Get Dependency Correlations Api V1 Telemetry Correlations Get

post.description: Evaluates multi-hop impact and deterministic risk for a proposed ChangeSet.
Generates an evidence-backed incident prevention and remediation report.
